summary: Loss of account region affinity causing inference tail p99 spikes and stream resets
description:
Issue summary: HorizonAI (dedicated) reports elevated tail latency (p99) and intermittent streaming resets for real-time chat traffic originating from APAC. Initial signal started 2026-02-20 08:45 UTC.

Impact: Approx 12% of requests for HorizonAI experienced >1.5s token generation p99 during the window; several streaming connections were reset mid-response causing partial outputs. Customer reported user-visible timeouts in production and opened a support escalation.

Observed behavior: Requests that historically stayed in ap-southeast pop are being routed through eu-west for a subset of accounts, increasing handshake and TTFB. Traffic appears to lose account-level region affinity then fall back to remote egress, triggering added TLS handshakes and KV cold starts on remote model shards.

Immediate mitigation request: Customer asked for a short-term route pin to ap-southeast and confirmation of no customer data egress outside expected regions.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use HorizonAI test account (account tag AHZ-310) in ap-southeast-1.
2) Send steady chat stream traffic with sequence lengths ~400 tokens against gpt-neox-20b.
3) Observe connection setup and route chosen via X-Redwood-Route header (internal header) and monitor backend pop selection.
4) Compare p50/p95/p99 over a 10-minute window and inspect any stream disconnects in client logs.
logs: 2026-02-20T08:46:12Z edge-proxy[proxy-12] WARN: selected-egress=eu-west-1; account-affinity=lost; sni=redwood-eu; tls-handshake=0.34s
2026-02-20T08:46:12Z serving-runtime[serve-07] ERROR: kv-cache-miss account=AHZ-310 route=eu-west-1 cold-warmup=true
Packet capture snippet (sensitive): sni mismatch observed when egress choice changed - stored in secure log store at /secure/logs/SUP-531224-pcap-1
comments: 2026-02-20 09:02 - Emma Liu (Support): Opened ticket after HorizonAI NOC reported user-visible slowdowns. Collected sample request IDs and initial logs from customer.
2026-02-20 09:25 - Liam Ortega (SRE): Acknowledged. Spun up capture on edge-proxy and routed HorizonAI test traffic through debug path. Noted mismatched account->region mapping in router cache.
2026-02-20 11:10 - HorizonAI (Customer): Confirmed production impact on ~7% of sessions; asked for temporary region pin until fix is applied.

2026-02-21 02:44 - Priya Patel (Routing Eng): We reproduced affinity drop when router health-check refresh coincided with account tag eviction. Preparing a hotfix to avoid eviction for dedicated accounts.
2026-02-24 08:15 - Liam Ortega (SRE): Hotfix deployed to canary (router v2.14.3). Monitoring shows reduction in cross-region routing for AHZ-310. Will promote to prod after 24h observation.
investigation_notes: 1) Timeline: affinity loss events correlate with periodic router cache GC job that runs every 6 hours. The GC had an off-by-one condition that considered dedicated-account tags stale under high-tag-count scenarios.

2) Root cause hypothesis: router cache eviction removed account->pop binding; subsequent request used global fallback scoring that favored eu-west due to transient weight bump from capacity reshuffle.
3) Additional effect: when egress flips, serving runtime sees KV prefix miss causing cold KV warmups adding ~150-400ms per request, amplifying p99.
4) Reproducible locally by simulating high tag churn and triggering the router GC; confirmed by integration test that previously passed and now fails intermittently.
5) Cross-checks: no billing or quota anomalies. Not an authentication issue. No model degradation found.
resolution:
Workaround: Temporary routing policy added to pin HorizonAI account AHZ-310 to ap-southeast-1 while fix is validated. Customer notified and verified reduced p99.

Fix deployed: Router cache eviction logic patched (router v2.14.3) to respect dedicated-account sticky TTL and to use conservative eviction when tag-count > 1000. Edge-proxy SNI mapping clarified to prefer account-specific SNI for dedicated customers. Hotfix promoted to canary on 2026-02-23 and to prod on 2026-02-24 after 24h observation with monitoring thresholds green.

Follow-ups: 1) Add unit/integration test covering eviction scenario (owner: routing team). 2) Add dashboard alert for >3% cross-region egress for dedicated accounts (owner: SRE). 3) Run a canary burn-in for 48h for high-tag-count customers.
monitoring: Alert created: GEO_AFFINITY_LOSS_DEDICATED - fires if >2% of requests for dedicated accounts go to remote egress for 10m
Grafana panel updated: HorizonAI account affinity heatmap added to /d/latency/horizonai-p99
Synthetic test: hourly synthetic stream pinned to ap-southeast for AHZ-310 to verify route stability
